lines: Had 'thee alone speaks all' ne'er rung, what sage
had wrangled, God, through wordy snares then?
l4.sanskrit_cite: vācya eṣāṃ tvam eveti nābhaviṣyad idaṃ yadi kaḥ kleśaṃ deva vāgjāleṣv akariṣyat sudhīs tadā

reads_against.argmap: If this 'you indeed are their expressible' had not been. → Without you-as-expressible, no wise one would toil in words.
c1_essence: Subtle yet whole, gross yet unseen; word-nets toiled in vain without you-as-expressible.

l2.plain_english: Had it never been that 'you alone speak them all' — which sage, O god, would ever have strained through tangled words?
